note: Forested Osage River bluff country. The camping spot a rig can use is the gravel parking lot with a privy above Clubhouse Lake, at the end of about a mile of unimproved gravel road that drops some 200 ft from Highway 133; the designated spots themselves are small clearings in the woods beside it, on the lake's dam and along the road, suited to tents. The small lake is about 60 m away through the trees and not in view from the lot. Other spots are mapped at the Osage Bluff Scenic Trail lot off Highway 133 and along a grown-in track in the middle of the area. Lot and spot sizes are not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - 7 mapped Primitive Camping symbols / GIS points in three groups; the pin is the main group at Clubhouse Lake, where the drivable spot is the gravel lot with a privy. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit, year-round per brochure. Pin move 50 m onto the lot. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays, but thin for an RV): the page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and 'Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack'; the brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas as well as by walk-in/backpack camping. No amenities are provided.' The 8/27/2019 map draws seven Primitive Camping symbols, matching the seven GIS layer-27 points. CLUSTERS: (a) Clubhouse Lake, reached by the MDC Unimproved Road from Hwy 133 at the south - three points: 38.39883,-92.11177 (the stored pin, beside the Parking Lot and Privy symbols), 38.40029,-92.11322 (north end of the lake's dam, walk across the dam from the river lot) and 38.39590,-92.10955 (beside the road by a small wildlife pond, ~380 m before the lot); (b) the middle unimproved road off Hwy 133 near Rocky Ridge Trl - two points (38.40360,-92.10378 and 38.40374,-92.10684) which on imagery lie under closed canopy along a faint, grown-in track with no visible lot beyond the one at the highway; (c) the Osage Bluff Scenic Trail lot off Hwy 133 at the north - one point by the lot (38.41180,-92.11047) and one on the trail (38.41089,-92.11455, walk-in). On leaf-off imagery every point is in woods; none shows a cleared drive-in pad. The only place a 23-ft rig can be parked at the main camp is the ~20 x 35 m gravel lot (GIS lot 293) with the privy; the designated point is in the trees ~40 m from it. Under the 2026-11-09 rule a designated point beside a lot keeps the entry; said plainly, for a motorhome this is lot camping with tent spots beside it.

ACCESS: the map classes the ~1.5 km road from Hwy 133 down to Clubhouse Lake as 'MDC Unimproved Road' (the contours show it dropping from ~800 ft to ~580 ft). On imagery it is a continuous light gravel road, one lane wide, to the lot. No 4WD or high-clearance wording on the page or brochure, no ford. Caveat written in the note.

PIN MOVE (50 m, out of the woods onto the lot): stored 38.39883,-92.11177 (GIS point 400, under canopy) -> 38.39856,-92.11226, the centre of the gravel lot with the privy as seen on the 0.47 m/px frame (MDC's GIS lot point 293 is 38.39836,-92.11219, at the lot's south end).

No split: the trail-lot point (c) is 1.5 km from the pin on its own entrance, but it is a single small lot; (b) has no usable lot. Nothing within ~1 km in campgrounds.json was checked because no split is proposed.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): Clubhouse Lake is ~230 x 90 m on imagery (about 4-5 acres, pond class) and ~60 m from the lot through continuous woods; the Osage River is ~250 m west below the dam. No water in view from the lot.
No horse camp: neither the page, brochure nor map labels any equestrian camp or trail here.
PHONE: (573) 815-7900 on the area page matches.
Season: the brochure's 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas' agrees with the stored manual year-round.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage, the 14-day line and the directions removed.
